clue.text: Witnessed crash but is away in London

indicators.note: a crash smashes things into a new jumble, so the letters of the first word are rearranged
is away tells us the two letters of the little word go missing from the pool before rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone saw a crash, but they are off somewhere in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Take WITNESSED, remove the I and S of 'is' ('away'), and rearrange the rest ('crash'). The definition is loose: the theatre district is a place in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The theatre and shopping district of central London is called by this name, so it is a location in the capital.

clue.text: Japanese root cut up has quite a bit of a bite

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to cut wood is to saw it

indicators.note: quite a bit of means most but not all, so the ending of the words is dropped

explanation.surface: A sliced-up Japanese root gives quite a kick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns SAW into WAS; 'quite a bit of' keeps ABI from 'a bite'. 'has' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This pungent green condiment served with sushi is made from a grated Japanese plant root.

clue.text: Keen for mum to run off

parts.note: mum means silent, and sh is a call for silence
a rill is a small stream, water running off

explanation.surface: Eager for one's mother to clear off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keen' is the adjective for a high piercing sound (as in a keening wail), not 'eager'; 'mum' is silence, not mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen sound is high and piercing, the same as a shrill one.

clue.text: Biological science redefined by germy loo

indicators.note: redefined means given a new shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A biology field gets a new meaning thanks to a germ-ridden toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of how organisms develop before birth is a branch of biology.

clue.text: Long speech is an attraction at the end of school

parts.note: a draw is something that attracts crowds

indicators.note: at the end of means the final letter of school is used

explanation.surface: A lengthy address is the big pull at the close of the school year.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech with long drawn-out vowels is slow and lengthened.

clue.text: Frenetically busy place engaged in philanthropy not very well

indicators.note: engaged in means held within, so the four central letters of philanthropy are used

parts.note: not very well means sick, poorly

explanation.surface: A frantic charity office is involved in giving, though not doing it very well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaged in' keeps the four letters at the heart of 'philanthropy', dropping four from each end.
explanation.definitionFit: A colony of tireless insects swarming about makes the standard image of a place full of frantic activity.

clue.text: Opposed to previous ball being a "first service"

parts.note: anti means against
past means former, earlier
O is round like a ball

explanation.surface: A tennis player objects to a previous ball being counted as a first serve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' is a course at a meal, not a tennis serve.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian starter course is the first dish served at a meal.

clue.text: Pitfall for member when rising

indicators.note: rising means the word is read upwards in this down light

parts.note: a member is a part of a body

explanation.surface: A hazard for a parliamentarian on standing up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitfall is a concealed hole set to catch animals, a kind of snare.

clue.text: Scheme for mountaineering trip is one-man short

indicators.note: trip means stumble, so the letters are knocked into disorder
short means lacking, so the letters of one-man are taken out of the pool

explanation.surface: A plan for a climbing expedition is a man down.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove ONEMAN from MOUNTAINEERING ('short') and rearrange the remaining eight letters ('trip').
explanation.definitionFit: A secret plot or underhand plan to achieve something is a scheme.

clue.text: Lively young women like coffees of French importation

indicators.note: importation means something is brought in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: lattes are milky coffees
de is French for of

explanation.surface: Bubbly girls fancy coffees brought over from France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for boisterous young women who drink and behave like lads.

clue.text: Abandon meagre growth

definitions.meaning: to abandon a plan is to cancel or call it off
stunted bushes and low vegetation on poor land

explanation.surface: Give up on a patch of sparse vegetation.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an informal verb for cancelling and a noun for stunted brushwood.

clue.text: Appealed for a dry run before took part in play

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, i.e. not drinking alcohol
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
performed a role on stage

explanation.surface: Someone pleaded for a sober rehearsal before appearing in a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dry' means alcohol-free here, giving TT (teetotal), not 'arid'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that appealed to you drew your interest, a synonym for being alluring.

clue.text: Ring — why text — to state musical works were complete disasters

parts.note: to ring is to give a bell, i.e. a phone call
in text-speak the word why is written as the letter Y
FL is the abbreviation for Florida, a US state
OPS is short for opuses, numbered musical compositions

explanation.surface: A call and a text message mock musical productions that flopped badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'were' is only a link joining wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Landing flat on the water is a painful dive, so the word is slang for total failures.

clue.text: 14 cut fails to have terminal effect

indicators.note: cut means the word is shortened by losing its final letter

parts.note: fails means stops working, conks out

indicators.note: terminal means at the end, so the closing letter of effect is used

explanation.surface: A reduced eating plan fails, with fatal consequences.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' shortens DIES to DIE; 'terminal' gives the last letter of 'effect'. 14 is the answer to 14-across, a law-making body.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese national parliament is called by this name, as were some historical German assemblies.

clue.text: Bird is sleep inducer, having right initial intonation

indicators.note: having means holding something within it

parts.note: the Sandman of folklore sprinkles sand to send children to sleep

indicators.note: initial means the first letter of intonation is used

explanation.surface: A bird is a sleep-bringer whose call starts on the right note.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sandman is the figure of folklore who sends children to sleep; 'having' signals the insertion, and 'initial' takes only the first letter of 'intonation'.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brown swallow-like bird that nests in sandy banks.

clue.text: Part of government redeploys legal ruse to have it included

indicators.note: redeploys means moves into new positions, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A branch of the state uses a lawful trick again to get something included.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of 'legal ruse' plus 'it' ('to have it included') are rearranged ('redeploys').
explanation.definitionFit: The law-making body is one of the three branches of the state, beside the executive and judiciary.

clue.text: Middle-aged position on time taken for growth

indicators.note: middle means the central letters of aged are taken

parts.note: a station is a post or position

explanation.surface: A middle-aged stance on how long it takes to grow up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Middle-aged' looks like a single adjective but splits: middle of 'aged'. 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The period of development in the womb between conception and birth.

clue.text: 14 fabrication

definitions.meaning: a legislature, a gathering of law-makers
the building of a product from its parts

explanation.definitionFit: A legislative body such as the Welsh one has this name, and putting parts together is too.

clue.text: 14 deception starts getting rumbled ever so slightly

parts.note: a con is a swindle, a deception

indicators.note: starts means the opening letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: A law-making body's deceit starts to be uncovered, just a little.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rumbled' is British slang for found out. 14 is the answer to 14-across.
explanation.definitionFit: The US national law-making body is known by this name.

clue.text: Spread of some odd or idle chatter management committee heard about

indicators.note: odd means the first and third letters of the word some are taken

parts.note: gas is idle talk, chatter

indicators.note: heard signals that the committee word is spelt as it is said

parts.note: a board of directors manages a company

explanation.surface: Gossip about a management committee spreads through some odd or idle talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' takes S and M (letters 1 and 3) from 'some'; 'heard' gives BORD, which sounds like BOARD.
explanation.definitionFit: A spread can be a lavish buffet, and the Swedish buffet of many dishes is exactly that.

clue.text: Pay off for busted dam returning to half of them

indicators.note: returning means the word is read backwards

parts.note: the Eder Dam in Germany was breached by the Dambusters raid of 1943

indicators.note: half of means the second two of its four letters are taken

explanation.surface: Settling the bill for a burst dam goes back to half of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns EDER into REDE; 'half of' takes EM from 'them'. The Dambusters were RAF crews who breached German dams in 1943.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear a debt or a mortgage by paying it is a standard sense.

clue.text: Have difficulty in expressing The Sound of Music

definitions.meaning: to struggle, make a great effort
a melody or tune, the sound of music, not the film

explanation.surface: Struggling to put the famous musical into words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Sound of Music' looks like the film title but simply means a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to struggle hard, and the noun is a passage of melody.

clue.text: Side to progress forward gradually

definitions.meaning: a side is a border or rim

explanation.surface: Shuffle sideways, inching forward a little at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a rim or border, and the verb means to move forward little by little.

clue.text: 14 to bring up receiving letters from the right

indicators.note: receiving means the first word takes the second inside it

parts.note: to bring up a child is to raise it

indicators.note: from the right means read in reverse, right to left

parts.note: letters are post, mail

explanation.surface: A law-making body raises questions about receiving correspondence from right-wing groups.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bring up' is a verb (raise a child), not 'mention'; 'from the right' signals reading backwards, and 'receiving' the insertion. 14 is the answer to 14-across.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's national law-making body is the classic example of an elected assembly passing laws.

clue.text: Shelter child from hanger-on

parts.note: the lee is the side sheltered from wind

explanation.surface: Protect a youngster from a parasite.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloodsucking worm, figuratively someone who clings on to exploit others.

clue.text: Kind soul regularly the subject of much love

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A gentle person is often the focus of great affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th letters of 'Kind soul'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone adored or worshipped, the object of devotion.

clue.text: Undesirable development with us needing to leave the queue

indicators.note: a development is a change of form, so the letters are reworked
the letters of us are taken out of the pool before rearranging

explanation.surface: An unwelcome turn of events means we must quit the queue.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove U and S ('us', 'needing to leave') from UNDESIRABLE and rearrange the rest ('development').
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a line of poor people waiting for free food, the word came to mean subsistence poverty.

clue.text: This is not on note with thank-you letter

indicators.note: is not on means the two letters of is are not included

parts.note: E is a musical note
ta is British informal for thank you

explanation.surface: Writing a thank-you note is not on, this time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is not on' removes IS from THIS, leaving TH. TA is British slang for 'thanks'.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the eighth character of the Greek alphabet, used in maths for angles.

clue.text: Conclusions of study group put into storage in the end — much later than 26

indicators.note: conclusions are endings, so the last letters of the next two words are taken

parts.note: a silo stores grain

indicators.note: the end of in is its final letter

explanation.surface: The study group's findings were archived until long afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conclusions of' takes Y and P; 'in the end' gives the last letter of 'in'. 26 is THETA, the eighth Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsilon is the twentieth Greek letter, coming well after theta, the eighth.

clue.text: He despatches word game

definitions.meaning: an executioner who kills by the rope
a guessing game drawing a gallows letter by letter

explanation.surface: He sends off a word puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: The executioner and the guessing game of letters share this name.
